correctness.rationale: The critical Lyapunov-Krasovskii derivative is an exact sum of two nonpositive defects whose common equality set has only the zero invariant trajectory. The characteristic equation has one simple neutral root and otherwise strictly stable spectrum; the exact center observable gives the cubic coefficient and sharp generic decay.

originality.rationale: Checked Ikeda literature covers stability boundaries, periodic bifurcations, multistability and the same c=0, mu=1 local degeneracy in a singular large-delay normal form. No checked source states the delay-independent critical global Lyapunov identity together with the all-fixed-delay sharp relaxation law. Residual coverage risk is explicit.

value.rationale: The result closes the nonhyperbolic stability endpoint for every delay and quantifies the transition from exponential to algebraic attraction with an exact delay-dependent coefficient.
